publication.snapshot_format: Wrapper contains original source path and SHA256; data is the complete source JSON except trainer_state_terminal.json, which contains explicitly selected terminal fields and the final logged loss record.
publication.screening: Snapshot fields were inspected and scanned for credential and raw CV/prompt-text keys. They contain adapter configuration, run metadata, aggregate evaluation metrics, and terminal training metrics; no credentials or raw CV/prompt text were found.

merge_retention_definition.exact_update: D = (B @ A) * scaling, computed in float32
merge_retention_definition.written_update: W_merged - W_before after merge into base dtype
merge_retention_definition.interpretation: Projection coefficient of the written update onto the intended update; not a norm ratio, energy fraction, or fraction of nonzero weights.
merge_retention_definition.reported_adapter: last adapter in the served merged chain

merge_retention_scope: Percentage of the last adapter's own parameter update retained by the served merge; not behavioral agreement or accuracy.
source_scope: read-only snapshot of completed CSCS outputs

interpretation.valid_scope: descriptive comparison of served merged checkpoints at matched operating points
cautions: Parameter counts are near-matched, not exactly equal: 58,085,376 versus 58,195,968, -0.1900%.
Changing window rank from 32 to 163 also changes parameterization and optimization geometry; alpha/r remains 2.
Merge retention differs materially across full, old-window and high-rank window adapters; this is not a capacity-only causal intervention.
All final adapters completed 341 steps and one epoch; terminal losses are last logged intervals at step 340, not whole-run averages.
Own-operating-point GPT-4o agreement is descriptive and is not matched-rate or hiring-ground-truth accuracy.
Primary seed-level uncertainty does not establish equivalence; no across-seed confidence interval is inferred from the seed mean.

quality.scope: greedy decisions at each model's own operating point; GPT-4o is a reference proxy
